channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Trump warns Starmer about UK-China relationship
item.description: Donald Trump has lashed out as Britain's prime minister visits Beijing, saying it's "very dangerous" for the UK to do business with China.

item.title: China lifts sanctions on MPs as Starmer says he wants President Xi to visit UK
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer emerged from talks with President Xi Jinping to announce that China would lift sanctions imposed on six members of the UK parliament, saying it "vindicated" his decision to reset Anglo-Chinese relations.

item.title: Trump could retaliate if countries get ‘too cosy’ with China, says political scientist
item.description: We spoke to Dr Eliot Cohen, former counselor at the US Department of State and now the Arleigh Burke Chair in Strategy at the Center for Strategic and International Studies.

item.title: Can Trump’s America First policy work in the face of China’s economic might?
item.description: Donald Trump has already made his feelings clear about Sir Keir Starmer's bid to build closer relations with Beijing, calling it "very dangerous".

item.title: Epstein files: Three million new pages released by US Justice Department
item.description: The US Justice Department has released more than three million pages of documents from its Jeffrey Epstein files, including videos and images, as well as other records withheld in the original release of documents in December.

item.title: Iran: Why US ground invasion could benefit China
item.description: As tensions escalate between the US and Iran, experts in China have said that any US ground invasion onto Iranian soil may in fact benefit China, pulling US military resource out of the Indo-Pacific, and away from Taiwan, which China has long claimed is a part of its territory.

item.title: Don Lemon: US civil rights leader on arrest of former CNN host
item.description: We spoke to the American civil rights leader Reverend Al Sharpton and began by asking him what more he knows about the arrest.

item.title: Melania: Is $75m movie about President Trump’s wife a Box Office flop?
item.description: It cost $75m to make and the director was accused of sexual misconduct and harassment by a series of women a decade ago.

item.title: How do people in China view Donald Trump?
item.description: We spoke to Shen Dingli, a professor of international affairs in Shanghai.

item.title: Iain Duncan Smith: Starmer negotiated ‘bad deal’ over China MP sanctions
item.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer has said China agreed to lift sanctions against six British MPs and peers after his talks with the Chinese leader Xi Jinping, insisting he had been able to raise "difficult issues" during their meeting.
